summary: A rejected awaited promise resumes the async context with an abrupt completion carrying the JavaScript rejection reason.

target.notes: The helper must bridge arbitrary JS rejection values into catchable compiler/runtime control flow without losing the original value.

semantics.rejection: await throws the rejection reason into the suspended async context
semantics.try_catch: surrounding JS try/catch observes the original reason

caveats: JavaScript rejection reasons are not restricted to Exception objects.
Task cancellation is not equivalent to Promise rejection.

tests.name: uncaught rejection rejects outer promise
tests.expected_behavior: outer promise rejects with numeric reason 5
